topic: Principles of pressure refueling and de-fueling
syllabus_extract: Principles of pressure refueling and de-fueling
specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the construction and requirements of typical aircraft fuel system and its components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of fuel system diagrams; Instructor supervision of theoretical concepts only
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft fuel system?
Name two methods used for refueling aircraft.
Why is pressure refueling preferred over gravity refueling for large aircraft?

topics: Definition and working principle of pressure refueling
Fuel tank pressure requirements and limits
Refueling nozzle design and sealing mechanisms
Fuel flow control valves and shut-off systems
Safety protocols during pressure refueling operations
development.content:
Definition and working principle of pressure refueling
Fuel tank pressure requirements and limits
Refueling nozzle design and sealing mechanisms
Fuel flow control valves and shut-off systems
Safety protocols during pressure refueling operations

topics: Principles of de-fueling and defueling procedures
Fuel transfer pumps and venting systems
Precautions against fuel spillage and contamination
development.content:
Principles of de-fueling and defueling procedures
Pressure differential management during de-fueling
Fuel transfer pumps and venting systems
Precautions against fuel spillage and contamination
Emergency de-fueling scenarios and response

topics: Comparison of pressure refueling and de-fueling systems
System components specific to pressure operations
development.content:
Comparison of pressure refueling and de-fueling systems
System components specific to pressure operations
Maintenance requirements for refueling equipment
Regulatory standards for fueling operations
Common failures and troubleshooting techniques

summary_questions: Explain the role of pressure differential in preventing fuel tank over-pressurization.
Describe the sequence of operations during a pressure refueling event.
Identify three critical safety measures required during de-fueling operations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of pressure refueling and de-fueling discussed in this lesson will assist in understanding fuel contamination issues covered in LP 06.
